name: Ballet
description:
Ballet is an agent and workflow automation platform for building AI-powered processes that can reason, take action, and run automatically.

Create specialized AI agents, chain them together into multi-step playbooks, and connect them to the tools and systems your team already uses through MCP servers. Playbooks can coordinate multiple agents and actions to complete end-to-end workflows instead of handling just a single prompt or task.

Ballet workflows can be launched manually or automatically from triggers including schedules, webhooks, Slack commands, form submissions, and other events. This makes it possible to turn repeatable operational processes into persistent AI-powered automations.

Use Ballet to:

- Build AI agents with specific roles, instructions, tools, and capabilities
- Combine agents and actions into reusable multi-step playbooks
- Connect external applications, data, and services through MCP
- Automate workflows using schedules, webhooks, Slack commands, forms, and other triggers
- Orchestrate processes that require multiple AI agents or tools working together
- Run repeatable workflows consistently without manually prompting an AI for every step

Example workflows include researching and enriching leads, generating recurring reports, processing inbound requests, coordinating customer or operational workflows, transforming information between systems, and automating internal processes that previously required several tools and manual steps.

With the Ballet connector, Claude can interact with your Ballet environment to help users work with their agents, playbooks, and automated workflows.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ballet to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ballet to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.ballet.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ballet MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ballet lists 31 MCP tools, including connect_mcp_server, create_agent, create_mcp_server, create_playbook, create_skill, create_tool, delete_agent, delete_mcp_server, delete_playbook, delete_skill, delete_tool, and get_agent.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ballet?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Ballet in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Ballet requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ballet is developed by Brainfish. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
